about: Daily candles of each bStock on Binance Spot against USDT, as the exchange records them (UTC days). series[ticker] = [date, open, high, low, close, quote volume in USDT, trades]. Market context only: not part of the record, not a valuation, not compared with the US share price.
source: Binance Spot public market data, /api/v3/klines, interval 1d
